ModMetaData.name: Mister Meeseeks
ModMetaData.author: Captain Muscles (Nathan Harbour) - RimWorld 1.6 compatibility port
ModMetaData.description: Hi I'm Mr. Meeseeks, look at me! My purpose is to help you with whatever you need. I will do anything to fulfill my purpose so I can go away! RimWorld 1.6 native-race test build; Humanoid Alien Races is not required.
